title: Epic: Make Bench Generic for MT/Microservices
description:
Remove Grafana-specific references and make bench work for any service. This aligns with issue #723 in GitHub.

## Goal
Enable bench to test any service (databases, microservices, etc.), not just Grafana instances.

## Key Changes
- Rename --grafana-* flags to --service-*
- Remove hardcoded Grafana version probing
- Add generic health check support
- Support service-name flag for multi-service testing

## GitHub Issues
- #723 Epic: Bench for all of Grafana
- #670 Rename grafana prefixed flags
- #671 Remove default probe for Grafana version
- #667 Add support for specifying the name of a service
- #672 Add generic support for health checks
- #666 Bench support for multitenant services

## Stakeholders
- Datasource squads
- Adam Yeats (MT team)
- All teams onboarding bench for non-Grafana services

title: GH#671: Remove default Grafana version probe
description:
Make version probing optional/configurable instead of required.

## Problem
- Not all services expose version endpoints
- Hardcoded to Grafana's /api/health endpoint
- Fails for generic services

## Solution
- Make version probing optional via flag: --probe-version (default: false)
- Allow custom version endpoint: --version-endpoint
- Skip version check if not configured

## Files to Modify
- pkg/grafana/instance.go (version probing logic)
- pkg/config/config.go (add flags)

Related: GitHub issue #671

title: GH#667: Add --service-name flag for multi-service testing
description:
Add support for specifying service name to enable multi-service/multi-instance testing.

## Use Case

## Changes
- Add --service-name flag (default: 'service')
- Include service name in logs, metrics, notifications
- Use service name in Prometheus labels

## Files to Modify
- pkg/config/config.go (add flag)
- pkg/reporter/* (include service name in output)
- pkg/metrics/* (add to metric labels)

Related: GitHub issue #667

title: Regenerate all deployment_tools bench versions with new codegen
description:
Apply the new codegen approach from CODEGEN_DEFAULTS_REFACTOR.md to all bench versions in deployment_tools.

## Background
The new codegen returns empty/zero values for flags that have CLI defaults, resulting in much cleaner bench commands.

## Tasks
1. Locate deployment_tools repository
2. Identify all bench versions that need regeneration
3. Run: go run ./generators/libsonnet/main.go generate --target-version <version>
4. Update RRC configurations to use new patterns
5. Test in staging RRC
6. Deploy to production RRCs

## Expected Outcome
Bench commands in RRCs will be cleaner, only showing explicitly configured flags.

Example: Instead of 20+ flags, only 3-4 necessary ones.

Related: CODEGEN_DEFAULTS_REFACTOR.md

title: GH#670: Rename grafana-prefixed flags to service-prefixed
description:
Breaking change: Rename all --grafana-* flags to --service-* for generic service support.

## Changes Required
- --grafana-url → --service-url
- --grafana-version → --service-version  
- --grafana-admin-user → --service-admin-user
- --grafana-admin-password → --service-admin-password
- --grafana-timeout → --service-timeout

## Files to Modify
- pkg/config/config.go (GrafanaConfig struct → ServiceConfig)
- cmd/test/command.go (help text and examples)
- generators/libsonnet/main.go (code generation)
- All test files

## Migration Strategy (3 phases)
1. Add new flags as aliases (backward compatible)
2. Deprecate old flags with warnings (1-2 releases)
3. Remove old flags (major version bump)

## Impact
- Breaking change for all users
- Need migration guide
- Update all internal tooling (RRCs, docs)

Related: GitHub issue #670
